items.title: XRP Ledger starts carrying fund records from Brazil operator overseeing $4 trillion
items.summary: The regulated operator is mirroring ownership of selected investment funds on XRPL while keeping its existing database as the official record.

items.title: Illinois draft crypto tax rules detail DeFi, stablecoin treatment
items.summary: Illinois’ draft rules spell out how its 0.2% digital asset transaction tax would apply to stablecoins, DeFi platforms, crypto bridges and self-custody transfers.

items.title: Robinhood to launch perps, weekend stock trading for US users
items.summary: The trading platform also introduced Robinhood Agents, which allows users to build their own AI agents within the app.

items.title: Abracadabra Proposes Winding Down MIM at Four Cents on the Dollar
items.summary: A Snapshot vote would liquidate the protocol, swap what collateral is left into ether and pay MIM holders pro rata.
